notes:
**The watchlist Refresh button now tells you whether it did anything.** It was
firing all along — it refetched the list — but nothing was ever awaited or
reported, so when the list came back unchanged, which is the normal case, the
screen was identical before and after. A button that repaints nothing is
indistinguishable from a dead one. It now disables while it runs and says what
happened afterwards, including "nothing changed", which is a result rather than
an absence of one.

A second defect turned up while fixing it: `loadWatchlist` handled its own
error and returned normally, so anything waiting on it could not tell a failure
from a success. The Refresh button was about to announce "nothing changed"
directly beneath "could not load the watchlist".

Same shape as the "Check now" fix in 1.3.7: the work was real, the
acknowledgement was missing.
